blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Elreen Ando failed to reach the podium and crashed to fifth place in the women’s 61-kilogram division of the Asian Games 2026 weightlifting competition on Friday at Nagoya City Trade and Industry Center. Ando lifted a total of 224 kgs–101 kg in the snatch and 123 kg in the clean and jerk. She missed her final 103-kg snatch attempt, as well as her first 123-kg and final 126-kg clean and jerk attempts.
